description: Fuentes para análisis aproximado. Las capas WMTS de Trek son imágenes renderizadas; el cálculo métrico usa DEM numéricos.

moon.name: Luna

dem.title: LRO LOLA Global Lunar Digital Elevation Model, 118 m
dem.notes: La etiqueta del producto define un factor de escala de 0.5 para los valores enteros almacenados. Producto global; ocupa varios GB.

trek_visual_layers: LRO LOLA South Pole Illumination / PSR

sunlight.provider: NASA GSFC PGDA / LRO LOLA PDS
sunlight.description: Visibilidad promedio del disco solar; fracción de los pasos de tiempo iluminados durante un ciclo de nutación lunar de aproximadamente 18.6 años.

earthView.provider: NASA GSFC PGDA / LRO LOLA PDS
earthView.description: Visibilidad promedio de cualquier parte del disco terrestre; no equivale a disponibilidad de enlace de comunicaciones.

additional_data.illumination: Implementada con mapas numéricos polares LOLA; representa promedio de largo plazo, no una ventana de misión específica.
additional_data.albedo: LRO Diviner reflectance or another documented lunar reflectance product
additional_data.craterFree: LROC crater/rock hazard product at a stated spatial resolution
additional_data.soilStability: A documented geotechnical proxy raster; do not infer it from the DEM alone
additional_data.ice: LRO Diviner Polar Resource Product (PDS4 ASCII triangular mesh) reports modeled depth to water-ice permafrost; LEND provides hydrogen evidence, not a direct ice probability. Both need documented conversion before use as a raster score.
additional_data.iceConfidence: The cited polar products do not supply a calibrated probability/confidence raster; keep this parameter unevaluated until an uncertainty layer is selected.

ice.provider: NASA PDS Geosciences Node / LRO Diviner
ice.reported_measurement: Annual temperature and modeled depth to water-ice permafrost
ice.limitation: Requires mesh-to-raster conversion; depth to stable ice is not a probability or abundance score.

ice.reported_measurement: Neutron-derived hydrogen evidence in near-surface regolith
ice.limitation: Hydrogen is indirect evidence; it is not a calibrated water-ice probability map.

iceConfidence.limitation: No cited source currently supplies a calibrated spatial confidence probability for the proposed ice score.

dem.title: MGS MOLA Global DEM, 463 m
dem.notes: DEM global referido al areoide; el producto completo ocupa aproximadamente 2 GB.

additional_data.illumination: A documented solar-illumination raster or Mars Climate Database output for the selected season and mission duration
additional_data.albedo: A documented TES or other calibrated reflectance product
additional_data.craterFree: CTX/HiRISE hazard information is local and resolution-dependent; there is no equivalent global, landing-scale hazard raster in the current catalog.
additional_data.soilStability: TES thermal inertia is available as a documented surface-property proxy; it is not a direct geotechnical bearing-strength measurement.
additional_data.ice: NASA-supported SWIM4IMIM provides GeoTIFF ice-consistency products over approximately 60S–60N at 3 km. Consistency is not a probability; product range and no-data handling must be preserved.
additional_data.iceConfidence: SWIM combines multiple evidence types but does not provide a calibrated probability raster; keep confidence separate and unevaluated unless a dedicated uncertainty layer is supplied.

ice.provider: NASA-supported Subsurface Water Ice Mapping project
ice.limitation: Consistency among evidence products is not a probability; product-specific scale, no-data, and longitude convention must be checked before conversion.

soilStability.provider: Arizona State University Mars Global Data Sets
soilStability.limitation: Thermal inertia is a surface-material proxy, not direct bearing strength or geotechnical stability.

illumination.format: Model output requiring selected season, latitude, and mission interval
illumination.limitation: A mission-wide value needs a chosen season and operational interval; a generic global percent would hide that dependency.

craterFree.provider: NASA PDS / University of Arizona HiRISE
craterFree.format: Regional imagery and digital terrain models
craterFree.limitation: Coverage is regional; high-resolution hazard checks belong after global screening.

iceConfidence.limitation: SWIM evidence consistency is not a calibrated probability or uncertainty raster.
